prompt:
TASK: Edit image 1. This is a local revision of the supplied artwork.
INPUT IMAGES (in supplied order):
Image 1: edit-target. Base image to edit; requested changes take precedence over preservation.
CHANGE REQUEST:
Open the clinic's glass entrance: swing the left glass door leaf fully open inward (out of the way, seen edge-on against the inside wall) so the doorway is open, and show Dr. Ananya standing IN the open doorway on the threshold, in front of all glass, with no glass pane or door frame crossing her body; her welcoming open left hand and her sandals are clearly in the open air of the doorway. The right glass leaf may stay closed. Keep Dr. Ananya's pose, size, face, smile, coat, stethoscope and position exactly, the elderly woman in the lilac sari walking toward her into the open doorway, the teal awning and its struts, the side window, the planters, the two waiting patients on metal chairs, the reception desk with registers and desk phone visible inside, the plants, street, trees, morning light and the plain white area at the top-left corner. No signage, no text.
PRESERVE: retain all areas, identity traits, acting, clothing, composition and lettering space outside the requested change. The change request overrides preservation where necessary; repair connected anatomy, contact objects and occlusion together. Supporting images supply only their stated roles. Do not copy their entire scene or pose.
OUTPUT: one edited image matching the target aspect. Do not add text, guide marks or a global style filter. Re-measure faces and mouths and inspect lettering space after adoption.
